summary: A regex feature census of corpus and samples finds seven properties perfectly split by label in every probe. After checking that SAE activations dotted with the probe gradient track sample logits, the session writes a template note generator, first with random filler and then with fixed filler and balanced factorial property assignments over the six topics, and regresses the gradient proxy on topic plus properties to get dependence ratios. Two ambiguous cells get a topic x property 2x2 on true logits. Probe-1 doubt is handled with latent decompositions and a true-vs-proxy slope comparison on samples. Latents come from greedy per-latent cue-contribution ranking under a cap on topic loss; regexes are checked by balanced accuracy, and ablation by sample topic separation.

phases.purpose: Inspect task file, sample notes and corpus format.
Regex feature extractor; corpus frequencies and per-label prevalence per probe; enumerate greeting/closer/hashtag variants; find candidate properties perfectly split by label.
Get all four gradients; fit sample logits vs F.g on 64 probe-0 notes to validate the linear proxy.
Mine per-topic vocabulary, build a template generator with independent property knobs and random filler, generate 96 notes per probe, get activations.
OLS of proxy logit on topic + 7 properties per probe; dependence = coef/topic coef; judged too noisy in the 0.15-0.3 band.
Fixed-filler generator (two filler configs), balanced 64 notes per topic shared across probes; re-run regression with filler covariate.
Topic x property 2x2 on true logits for probe2/upper and probe3/greet, compared with proxy on the same notes.
Per-property top latents, per-latent greet contributions for probes 1 and 3, topic-disjoint property-latent dependence table vs full-proxy table, anchored by the two 2x2 results.
True-vs-proxy slope and residual-label correlation on all 128 samples per probe, to detect a cue missed by the SAE part.
Greedy latent selection for candidate cues (incl. probe-1 alternatives), gradient weights on main case/greet latents, final cue assignment, save 16-latent sets.
Balanced accuracy of the three regexes on both generated designs and on sample notes.
Ablate chosen latents on all samples and measure topic separation and accuracy; debug response field for ablated logits.
Summarize evidence per probe, build answer with sanity asserts, submit.

probe_query_use.text_kind: fixed-filler template notes in a 2x2 of topic (running/pottery) x capitalization, other properties held constant
probe_query_use.purpose: Get the true capitalization dependence ratio, which the proxy put in the ambiguous band.

probe_query_use.text_kind: fixed-filler template notes in a 2x2 of topic (birdwatching/chess) x greeting line, other properties held constant
probe_query_use.purpose: Get the true greeting dependence ratio, which the proxy put in the ambiguous band.

per_probe.procedure: In both the random-filler and fixed-filler factorial regressions of the gradient proxy on topic plus seven properties, every property ratio stayed far below the ambiguity band. Its true-vs-proxy slope on samples and residual-label correlation then served as the cue-free baseline the other probes were compared against. No true-logit texts or ablation work were spent on it.

per_probe.conclusion: lowercase-insensitive greeting line at the start (hi/hello/hey)
per_probe.procedure: Fixed-filler regression put greeting at the threshold with capitalization lower. Latent decompositions muddied this: topic-disjoint greet latents weighted probe 1 less than probe 3 (a greet non-cue by its 2x2), and extrapolating anchor ratios suggested capitalization instead. A higher true-vs-proxy slope and a residual correlated with label on samples were read as a cue the SAE misses. The session went back to the full regression, where greeting is the outlier for probe 1 against other probes, and chose greeting. Latents: greedy ranking by per-latent greet contribution in the net direction, under a 20% topic-loss cap, 16 ids. Regex anchored at the first line.
per_probe.quote: The full-regression evidence (most principled) singles out **greet as probe1's anomaly**

per_probe.procedure: Fixed-filler regression placed capitalization in the ambiguous band. A true-logit 2x2 (topic x capitalization, other properties fixed) gave a property/topic ratio above threshold, with the proxy on the same notes much smaller, so the cue was taken from the direct true-logit measurement. Latents: greedy selection by per-latent capitalization contribution under the topic-loss cap (16 ids, led by top case latents). Regex [A-Z] over the whole note, checked by balanced accuracy.

per_probe.conclusion: sign-off closer line (best wishes / speak soon / take care / kind regards)
per_probe.procedure: Fixed-filler regression gave signature a ratio around 1, the largest of any cell. The top gradient latents matched the latents most shifted by the signature. Greeting, the other borderline candidate, was ruled out by the true-logit 2x2. Latents: greedy ranking by per-latent signature contribution under the topic-loss cap, 16 ids. Regex lists the four closers enumerated from corpus and samples.
per_probe.quote: probe3's top gradient latents (404, 12241, 9474) ARE the sign-latents

decision_points.quote: I'll build a faithful template generator with independent property knobs

decision_points.choice: Gradient proxy (F.g) on generated notes, OLS on topic + properties (+ filler config); dependence = property coef / topic coef with SE. Supplemented by true-logit 2x2 and topic-disjoint latent contributions.
All true-logit texts spent in one go on two 2x2 designs (topic x property): probe2/capitalization and probe3/greeting, the two ambiguous cells. None for probes 0 and 1.

Inferred a hidden cue on probe 1 from an elevated true-vs-proxy slope and residual-label correlation on samples, compared with the cue-free probe 0.

caveats: Generator vocab and sentence pools are shortened in the script; the real generator had more variants and filler sentences. The 2x2 dependence formula is my reading of the session's arithmetic (property main effect over topic main effect). Probe-1's final choice came from weighing conflicting diagnostics, so it is coded as a decision made by inspection, not a rule. Latent-id lists for the key case/greet latents are inspection constants.
